queue.topic: Income tax disputes under the Income-tax Act 2025 (in force from 1 April 2026): assessment and reassessment notices, the time limits, faceless procedure, appeals to CIT(A) and the ITAT, stay of demand and what changed from the 1961 Act; confirm commencement and transition provisions from official sources.

Divorce, maintenance and child custody in India: grounds, mutual consent and the cooling-off period, interim and permanent maintenance (Rajnesh v Neha guidelines), custody and guardianship principles, jurisdiction and enforcement; informational only.

Succession to property without a will under Hindu law: classes of heirs, daughters' coparcenary rights after Vineeta Sharma, self-acquired versus ancestral property, Arunachala Gounder, mutation, succession certificate and legal heir certificate, with a short contrast with other personal laws.

Title, possession and ownership disputes: verifying title before purchase, adverse possession (Ravinder Kaur Grewal and later rulings), cancellation of registered sale deeds under Section 31 Specific Relief Act, co-owner disputes and partition, limitation.

Cheque dishonour under Section 138 NI Act: notice and limitation, presumptions, interim compensation under Section 143A, appeals and Section 148, company directors under Section 141, parallel civil recovery and recent Supreme Court directions.

Termination, gratuity and dues: how an employee's termination is tested, gratuity eligibility and forfeiture under the Payment of Gratuity Act and the Code on Social Security 2020 position, notice pay, full and final settlement, forums; confirm commencement status of the Codes.

Cyber fraud and online scam remedies in India: reporting channels (1930, cybercrime portal), bank liability and RBI limited-liability circulars, IT Act and BNS offences, freezing and refund of funds, intermediary obligations.

Buying and registering property in Uttar Pradesh and Noida: stamp duty and registration, circle rates, sub-registrar process, mutation, authority transfer charges and no-dues, common defects in the chain of documents; verify current UP notifications.

Directors and company disputes: directors' duties and personal liability under the Companies Act 2013, Section 447 fraud, officer in default, disqualification, striking off, and when veil piercing applies; recent Supreme Court and NCLAT positions.

Challenging and enforcing domestic arbitral awards: Section 34 grounds and limits, Section 37 appeals, Section 36 enforcement and stay, Section 9 interim relief, emergency arbitration, and the Supreme Court's recent rulings on court powers to modify awards.
